Aalborg East Full-Scale EBPR Activated Sludge Community

An engineered full-scale activated sludge microbial community from the Aalborg East wastewater treatment plant in Denmark carrying out enhanced biological phosphorus removal. The community was profiled with an 18.2 Gb Illumina metagenome and qFISH, revealing phosphate-removal organisms including Candidatus Accumulibacter and Tetrasphaera-related Actinobacteria, flanking substrate-providing bacteria, and metagenomic enrichment for phosphate metabolism and biofilm/floc formation functions.
